verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly documents building blocks for recurring/scheduled automation — the CLI channel is called out for "scripted/scheduled workflows", standalone agents can authenticate headlessly via OAuth client credentials for unattended runs, and the agent-identity model on agents.ramp.com states "Long-running access — for background agents that run on a schedule." However there is no evidence of a native Ramp scheduler/cron UI or workflow-orchestration feature; recurring execution relies on the user's own external scheduler invoking the CLI/API/webhooks. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduling/orchestration engine, concrete recurring-job examples/tutorials, and independent confirmation of scheduled agent runs in production.
